title: studio → a runner: one model job (download or delete weights, delete a shared LoRA file)
description: From API 1.16 (contracts/README.md, Models and model jobs). Subject cmd.model.<host>.<env> (stream CMD, work queue; durable models-<host>-<env>, max_ack_pending 1, ack wait 60 s), Nats-Msg-Id <job_id>:1. `owner_id` = the admin who asked. Studio releases at most one job per host at a time. The runner works on it beside its runs (a separate worker: disk and network, no GPU memory), sends `+WIP` every 10 s while it works, publishes evt.model.status running, evt.model.progress, then one terminal status, waits for its ack, then acks the command. A redelivery (the runner restarted) resumes: snapshot_download keeps the partial files in local_dir. Everything the runner needs beyond this (repo, revision, allow_patterns, dir, the shared components) is its own pack's model.yaml: never a token, a URL, a path or bytes here.

model.description: download, delete: a model id of the env's models key

variant.description: download: the variant (absent = the first); delete: the variant (absent = every variant of the model on the host)

licence.description: download of a variant whose source.must_accept is true: the licence the admin accepted and the SHA-256 of its UTF-8 text as the models key published it. The runner fails the job `licence` when its pack's text hashes otherwise

lora_id.description: lora_delete: the shared LoRA (its SHA-256): every file of the host's index with that hash is deleted
